notes: The store page now sells one option only, Compatibility: A1 mini. Its Product Features update says the Smooth PEI Plate for X1/P1/A1/P2S/X2D/H2 Series is no longer available and names the Bambu Engineering Plate as the replacement; option-scoped values are therefore given for the A1 mini value only.

Store "Usable Print Size" (350*320mm / 256*256mm / 180*180mm), "Packaging Size" (408*388*17mm / 300*270*17mm / 220*190*15mm) and "Packaging Weight" (0.822kg / 0.45kg / 0.23kg) list three sizes with no option labels. The packaging values are not mapped to the A1 mini option (that would rest on row order only); they stay the page's product-scope unverified rows.

Thickness: the store table gives "Smooth PEI Sheet - 0.125mm / Spring Steel Plate - 0.5mm/0.4mm" without saying which size has which steel; the store description and the wiki say 0.5 mm spring steel. No curated physical.thickness: the A1 mini value is not stated. The page row (unverified) keeps the composite text; its value_num 0.125 is the PEI sheet only.

Material: the wiki ("a carefully selected PEI sheet ... spring steel ... 3M adhesive") agrees with the store's Material row ("Smooth PEI Sheet + Magnetic Spring Steel Plate"), written as part.material with the same value as the page row; the surface layer it names is part.surface_type "Smooth PEI".
Plates wiki Important Notice (two generations, QR code recognition) concerns the 256x256 mm plates only, not the A1 mini size.

Store Considerations: higher curling risk "with the Smooth PEI Plate on the A1" (not the A1 mini; the A1 option is not sold); maintenance advice (bubbles: heat at no less than 80 degrees; no acetone; 600-grit sanding) is prose, not a spec.

Bed temperatures per filament on this plate (wiki 35-120 ℃ by material; store 35~110℃) have no plate-type registry key (print_settings.bed_temp is filament-only); they are kept as the quotes of the material relations.

Adjudication (second extraction): taken — compatible_with A1 mini with the store's option value as evidence (beside the wiki row). Not taken — physical.thickness as the composite store text (a string on a number key would make a false conflict with the page row's 0.125); printing.usable_print_size at product scope (the page row already carries the same text); printing.usable_print_size "180*180 mm" for A1 mini cited to the wiki (the wiki calls it the build plate dimensions, kept as product.length/width; the store row names no option); package.length/width/height/weight for A1 mini (the store rows name no option, so only row order would tie them to it).
